newsitem.title: USA: Echlin sees flat Q2 earnings, sales.
newsitem.headline: Echlin sees flat Q2 earnings, sales.

text.p: Echlin Inc said on Tuesday it expects flat second quarter earnings and sales for the period ending February 28, 1997, compared with last year's second quarter.
In last year's second quarter, Echlin, a maker of automotive parts, reported sales of $732.4 million and earnings per share of $0.38.
"Unit sales continue to be weak, and are expected to be flat for the entire second quarter, as they were in the first quarter, chairman and chief executive Frederick Macheski said in a statement.
Echlin said returned goods from customers have been at higher-than-normal levels.
Earnings per share for fiscal 1997, which ends in August, are expected to be in the $2.60 to $2.70 range, including a gain of $0.07 from the sale of Sensor Engineering, Echlin said.
Echlin's fiscal 1996 sales totaled $3.13 billion and earnings per share were $2.30.
"Our long-standing target of increasing earnings per share by 15 percent annually is doable," Mancheski said.
